notes:
Full-depth fan-out: family "Rust refoundation — R0–R11: reconciliation, evidence, oracles, cutover". Scene ids derive from the bound record paths; glyph terms are the bound records' own heading words. Presentation mappings are declared craft. Not corpus-complete claims beyond the frozen inventory: see the product receipt fulldepth-receipt-2026-09-21.md for exclusions and census-delta notes.
2026-10-07 craft rework (expression lane 6): every scene redrawn to the craft law — 100% non-text formations, 4 colour movements across 4 grounds, 8/11 adjacent pairs held still, stage text stripped to the scene's own name (76 words/journey), no metadata on the stage; register: Actuation — living articulation. Identity fields (journey id/description, scene id/name/character) unchanged.
2026-10-07 deepen pass (expression lane 6): fd-s1-rust-refoundation-09-r3-runtime ("R3 — Actualisation and realised runtime") stands in 3d — the articulation joint — the third dimension is the joint itself: the driver plane stands forward in z, the follower plane answers behind it, and the articulation is the depth between them; the depth scene carries the journey's authored morph (vortexSpiral trajectory, pulse drive, law product, rates 0.14/0.09); the field moves through three physics states (held, deep, carried) with particle props — material, grain, halo, opacity, roundness, softness, irregularity, elongation, contrast — travelling between them and holding within rests. Identity fields unchanged; titles stand.

glyph_rationales.0: the first station of the record's own movement path: ground before any move.
glyph_rationales.1: the record's own first move, marked in notation as its path numbers itself.
glyph_rationales.2: the second station of the record's own movement path.
glyph_rationales.3: the third station of the record's own movement path.
glyph_rationales.4: the fourth station of the record's own movement path.
glyph_rationales.5: the fifth station of the record's own movement path.
glyph_rationales.6: the sixth station of the record's own movement path.
glyph_rationales.7: the seventh station of the record's own movement path.
glyph_rationales.8: the eighth station of the record's own movement path.
glyph_rationales.the joint: the joint — the pivot where motion actually lives; articulation is a joint moved, not a part described.
glyph_rationales.the bearing: the bearing — the round seat a turning part rides in; freedom held inside a fit.
glyph_rationales.the driver: the driver — the small mover that hands its motion to the next part.
glyph_rationales.the link: the link — the connection between members — the living articulation of the whole.
glyph_rationales.the stock: the stock — the fitted body of a part; the machined block the motion works through.
glyph_rationales.the lever: the lever — the angled member that turns force into work.
glyph_rationales.the machine bed: the machine bed — the level surface every moving part is mounted to.
glyph_rationales.5→0: the path's own completion sign: the last move returns into the first.
glyph_rationales.→: the move itself: one term passing into the next, continuity drawn as an arrow of motion.
glyph_rationales.∴: therefore: the record's claim standing after its own reasons.
glyph_rationales.×: the crossing: one encounter meeting another without either dissolving.
glyph_rationales.Ω: the closing term: the path arrived at its end, which is its ground.
